content: This document provides a summary of information about the product and does not include all possible details. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your use. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice and should not replace the guidance of your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. While using this medication, laboratory and/or medical tests (such as viral load and T-cell counts) should be conducted. It is important to attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. If you miss a dose, take it after a meal as soon as you remember. However, if more than six hours have passed since the missed dose, skip it and take your next dose at the regular scheduled time. Store the medication in its original bottle at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Keep the drying agent (desiccant) in the bottle and ensure the bottle is tightly closed when not in use. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard the product when it is expired or no longer needed.
